author: DOC-030 source-review author agent (access-2)

prerequisites: A throwaway Business User (doc030.access2.bu.*@helix.example) signed in to the Portal with a fresh sign-in link from the lab Mailpit. It was JIT-provisioned, and its first run was finished through the API with Department Engineering.
Seeded Before you submit links: four Knowledge links and one external link to intranet.helix.example.

DOC-030 Knowledge Items created by the seeded Administrator through the API: a published Everyone item with a supporting and a primary Document and Guidance; a published Everyone item whose primary Document is marked Confidential; one whose only Document is Confidential; and Legal only, draft and archived items.
scenarios.expected: Only eligible published Knowledge appears and allowed files open through their intended links. Unpublished or out-of-audience items and their files remain unavailable; a broken external link does not block the Request form.
scenarios.actual: 11 recorded steps passed (one of them signed out). Before you submit on the Portal home listed How to ask legal for help, Contract review turnaround times, When you need a DPA, Using customer names in marketing and Helix intranet - Legal. Every Knowledge link pointed at a published Everyone item. The Contract review form had no links, so the lists differ. How to ask legal for help opened in the same tab with From Legal above its title and a Guidance section, and Your requests returned to /portal. The shared DOC-030 guidance link listed the primary Document first, then the supporting one. Download gave each current Version byte for byte. There was no version picker or embedded reader, and Guidance showed the written text. On the item whose primary Document is Confidential, only the supporting Document appeared. The Confidential Document's download address answered 404 and the open one 200. After Legal added a Version, Download and the earlier saved address both served the new file. Draft, Legal only, archived and unknown items returned to /portal, and their item and file addresses answered 404. After Legal unpublished the guidance, its page returned to /portal and its saved download address answered 404. Republishing restored it (200). Helix intranet - Legal showed intranet.helix.example beneath the label and opened a new tab, which failed to load. The original tab stayed on /portal, and the Legal question form then submitted with Thanks! Your request has been submitted to legal. The Portal navigation had Requests, Approvals, Contracts, Matters and Auto-Docs, with no Knowledge. /knowledge sent the Business User to /portal, the staff Knowledge API answered 403, and the item page had no editing controls. A signed-out browser went to /portal/login, with item and file answering 401. Portal Help search for the guidance title found no Knowledge Item.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer. It is not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
